rule: higher confidence wins (dense certain / probable / guess count as high / medium / low against the first-pass entry's confidence; an unrated first-pass entry ranks below low); ties go to the first pass

how_applied.first_pass_wins: the dense entry is not written to the spines_<video>_dense.jsonl frame (the frame record keeps it in dense_conflicts and names it in notes); a dense book with no other emitted sighting disappears from the merge
how_applied.dense_wins: the frame record's dense_conflicts entry carries drop_first_pass: true with the first-pass sighting (video_id, frame, wall_id, title, author, file, line); gen_books_eco.py (patched, CONFLICT_DROP) skips that consolidated sighting at ingestion, so the consolidation itself (books_by_wall_eco.json, books_seen.json) is unchanged for the first-pass side
how_applied.several_pairs: a dense entry in several pairs is emitted only when it wins them all; a first-pass entry is dropped only when the dense entry that beat it is emitted
